stem: Which sentence from the selection best establishes how the author’s mother approaches her situation?

options.label: A
options.text: Like most mothers, my mom wants the best for me.

options.label: B
options.text: She has been paralyzed from the waist down for most of her life, and all of mine.

options.label: C
options.text: She couldn’t hike the volcano in Hawaii with the rest of the family or go cliff-jumping in Mexico.

options.label: D
options.text: No matter how good or bad the chances are of something working out in her favor, she always tries.
